desc: Derive the structural condition for a valid Snowflake Tree centered at c: choose x neighbors of c, each chosen branch must have at least y other neighbors (capacity a=deg(v)-1).
Implement per-center solution: compute deg[], collect a=deg(v)-1 over neighbors, sort descending, and evaluate candidate 1 + x*(a[x-1]+1) for each valid x; track global max size.
Ensure O(N log N) complexity via degree-sum sorting bound, efficient stdin parsing, output N - max_size.
Cross-check against all three provided samples (all PASSED).
Verify edge cases: paths, stars, leaf centers, x>=1/y>=1 enforcement, branches with a<1 skipped.
